description:
Short title
CDS AI peak integration add-on

What should the AI do?
Our CDS vendor offers an 'AI-assisted' peak integration add on for the QC HPLC and CE methods. It integrates the peaks automatically.

Where will it be used?
QC laboratory

Does the AI output directly affect a batch, a GMP record, a QC result, a release or a process setting?
Yes, directly. integration -> reported QC results

What kind of AI is it?
A supplier's 'AI feature', details unknown

What happens with the output?
A trained person checks and approves each output before it is used

Who checks the output, and how?
analyst reviews the integration as usual before results are reported. vendor won't tell us how it works under the hood

What data goes into it?
Confidential company data

Who provides it?
Bought from a supplier, installed with us. add-on to our CDS
